articles.headline: Ronaldo responds with double and World Cup record
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo clapped back at critics after becoming the first player in history to score in six different World Cups with a brace vs. Uzbekistan.

articles.headline: 'Every ball I touched went wrong' - Kalidou Koulibaly on Norway horror show
articles.description: Kalidou Koulibaly acknowledged he was culpable for Senegal's 3-2 FIFA World Cup defeat by Norway at the MetLife Stadium on Monday, which leaves their prospects of reaching the knockouts hanging by a thread.

articles.headline: In a World Cup on home soil, El Tri is making Mexico proud
articles.description: At Qatar 2022, there was a divide between Mexico and the country they represented. That's all changed at this World Cup on home soil.

articles.headline: Ronaldo: World Cup clash with Messi would be 'awesome'
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo said facing Lionel Messi's Argentina in a World Cup knockout-stage showdown "would be awesome" after scoring twice in Portugal's 5-0 win over Uzbekistan on Tuesday.
